sentences.text: Offshore, help may be an hour or more away, so first aid skills matter.
Start by making sure the scene is safe for you.
Then check whether the person responds and is breathing normally.
Call for help early, on VHF channel sixteen or by phone, because the Coast Guard can arrange medical advice and evacuation.
If the person isn’t breathing normally, start CPR: push hard and fast in the center of the chest, one hundred to one hundred twenty compressions a minute, about two inches deep.
Use an AED if you have one.
Your license requires current CPR and first aid training, so keep it fresh.
